mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video ( author_id, category_id, title, description, cover_url, original_cover_url, cover_list_url, cover_detail_url, video_url, original_video_url, duration, status, view_count, like_count, favorite_count ) VALUES ( #{authorId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{originalCoverUrl}, #{coverListUrl}, #{coverDetailUrl}, #{videoUrl}, #{originalVideoUrl}, #{duration}, #{status}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{favoriteCount} )
mapper.select:
SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, COALESCE( v.cover_list_url, v.cover_detail_url, CASE WHEN v.cover_url LIKE 'cover/auto/%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'http://%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'https://%' THEN v.cover_url END ) AS coverUrl, v.video_url AS videoUrl, v.duration, v.status, v.reject_reason AS rejectReason, v.review_deadline AS reviewDeadline, v.review_timeout_notified AS reviewTimeoutNotified, v.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE( v.cover_detail_url, v.cover_list_url, CASE WHEN v.cover_url LIKE 'cover/auto/%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'http://%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'https://%' THEN v.cover_url END ) AS coverObjectName, v.video_url AS videoObjectName,
u.id AS authorId, u.username AS authorUsername, u.nickname AS authorNickname,
c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName
FROM video v LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON v.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN video_category c ON v.category_id = c.id
WHERE v.status = 'PENDING' AND v.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY v.create_time ASC

reject_reason = #{rejectReason},
publish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0

v.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName
FROM video v LEFT JOIN video_category c ON v.category_id = c.id
WHERE v.author_id = #{authorId} AND v.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.id DESC
SELECT view_count FROM video WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, COALESCE( v.cover_list_url, v.cover_detail_url, CASE WHEN v.cover_url LIKE 'cover/auto/%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'http://%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'https://%' THEN v.cover_url END ) AS coverUrl, v.duration, v.view_count AS viewCount, v.like_count AS likeCount, v.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, v.publish_time AS publishTime, v.author_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, v.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName FROM video v INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.author_id INNER JOIN video_category c ON c.id = v.category_id WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY v.publish_time DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, COALESCE( v.cover_list_url, v.cover_detail_url, CASE WHEN v.cover_url LIKE 'cover/auto/%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'http://%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'https://%' THEN v.cover_url END ) AS coverUrl, v.duration, v.view_count AS viewCount, v.like_count AS likeCount, v.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, v.publish_time AS publishTime, v.author_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, v.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName FROM video_like vl INNER JOIN video v ON vl.video_id = v.id AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON v.author_id = u.id INNER JOIN video_category c ON v.category_id = c.id WHERE vl.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY vl.id DESC

SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, COALESCE( v.cover_list_url, v.cover_detail_url, CASE WHEN v.cover_url LIKE 'cover/auto/%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'http://%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'https://%' THEN v.cover_url END ) AS coverUrl, v.duration, v.view_count AS viewCount, v.like_count AS likeCount, v.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, v.publish_time AS publishTime, v.author_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, v.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName FROM video_favorite vf INNER JOIN video v ON vf.video_id = v.id AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON v.author_id = u.id INNER JOIN video_category c ON v.category_id = c.id WHERE vf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY vf.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE video SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, video_url = #{videoUrl}, duration = #{duration}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE video SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(), deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, purge_after = #{purgeAfter}, purge_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{videoId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.title, v.author_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, COALESCE( v.cover_list_url, v.cover_detail_url, CASE WHEN v.cover_url LIKE 'cover/auto/%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'http://%' OR v.cover_url LIKE 'https://%' THEN v.cover_url END ) AS coverUrl, v.status, v.deleted_at AS deletedAt, v.deleted_by AS deletedBy, v.purge_after AS purgeAfter, v.purge_attempts AS purgeAttempts, v.purge_error AS purgeError FROM video v LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.author_id WHERE v.is_deleted = 1 ORDER BY v.deleted_at DESC, v.id DESC
SELECT * FROM video WHERE id = #{videoId} AND is_deleted = 1
SELECT id FROM video WHERE is_deleted = 1 AND purge_after IS NOT NULL AND purge_after <= #{now} ORDER BY purge_after ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM video WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status != 'PROCESSING' AND (cover_list_url IS NULL OR cover_detail_url IS NULL) AND ( original_cover_url LIKE 'cover/%' OR cover_url LIKE 'cover/%' ) AND COALESCE(original_cover_url, cover_url) NOT LIKE 'cover/processed/%' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE video SET purge_attempts = purge_attempts + 1, purge_error = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{videoId} AND is_deleted = 1
UPDATE video SET status = 'PROCESS_FAILED', process_error = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE video SET review_timeout_notified = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0 AND review_timeout_notified = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM video WHERE id = #{videoId} AND is_deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE video SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count + #{delta}, 0) WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE video SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count + #{delta}, 0) WHERE id = #{videoId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_deleted = 0
